items.title: 10 Extra Hours a Week, Handled by AI
items.summary: In episode 1027 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Dr. Dilani Kahawala, Co-Founder and CEO of Anna, about where she hopes to take Anna in the next few years. She describes a future in which a family has a team of AI agents handling its admin and working out what needs doing to keep the household running, giving parents 10 more hours in their week.

items.title: When Does an Autonomous AI System Need a Kill Switch?
items.summary: If an AI agent behaves unexpectedly, how—and when—should it be stopped? In this short, the authors of Architecting for Autonomy, Philip O'Shaughnessy & Anjali Jain, explain when autonomous systems need a kill switch and why teams should define shutdown triggers, escalation paths, and safe recovery procedures before agents enter production. Learn more about Architecting for Autonomy: https://hubs.la/Q04tZ_p50 #AgenticAI #AIAgents #AISafety #EnterpriseAI #AIEngineering #ManningBooks
